# Safety Protocol
1. As a direct hire of NanoTrasen and Central Command, your safety is paramount. [color=#ff0000]Code Red[/color] or above, all NanoTrasen personnel should seek shelter, with exception of the Central Command Enforcer who should continue their duties.
2. In the event of a [color=#ec9ba4]Code Gamma[/color], all Central Command and NanoTrasen Personnel are to communicate and gather on the Bridge and await ERT support.
3. In the event of contract terminations, all Central Command and NanoTrasen Personnel will be escorted off station by a NanoTrasen marine squad.
